dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000qw5x](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000qw5x) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Jul 29 2025 18km SE of Jutiapa. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 14.1377 longitude -89.8349. It impacted 1082339 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
